_comment: 2026 Senate cycle configuration for the control simulation. dem_safe_seats / rep_safe_seats count seats NOT in the competitive list below (holdovers + safe 2026 races such as FL, NE, MT). They are derived from the current 53R/47D Senate minus the competitive seats by current holder: of the 9 competitive races, Democrats hold GA, MI, NH (3) and Republicans hold NC, ME, OH, TX, IA, AK (6), so dem_safe = 47-3 = 44 and rep_safe = 53-6 = 47. dem_majority_threshold is 51 because the sitting VP (R) breaks 50-50 ties. lean_margin is a Dem-minus-Rep fundamentals prior (the 2024 presidential margin in the state) used only when a race has no polling yet; polls override it. Candidate names drive both the Wikipedia poll scrape (matched by surname) and the per-race cards. MI is primary-pending (Aug 4) - Stevens is a placeholder for the leading Dem matchup and is easily swapped. wikipedia overrides the default article title when it differs (Ohio is a special election).
